item.title: Courthouse, rec centers, city offices to close for Presidents Day
item.description: City rec centers, Douglas County District Court and more will be closed Monday for Presidents Day, but downtown parking will be free and trash pickup will occur as scheduled. Here are more notes and details for the holiday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Mardi Gras parade to jazz up Mass Street on Fat Tuesday
item.description: Laissez les bons temps rouler. Lawrencians can get a feel for Mardi Gras festivities at this year’s celebration downtown. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Cultural Arts Commission selects artist for Vermont Street garage mural
item.description: The Lawrence Cultural Arts Commission on Wednesday selected a mural proposal from Tokeya Waci U Richardson, Oglala Lakota and Haliwa-Saponi, to adorn a wall of the Vermont Street parking garage. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Senate passes bill scrutinizing free lunch families, dodging challenges from some Republicans
item.description: A contingent of Kansas Republicans narrowly advanced a bill that would increase scrutiny of households that qualify for free and reduced lunch, but it fielded pushback from Democrats and fellow Republicans. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Sparky, looking for Valentine’s love, likes long naps and thoughtful wrestling with other dogs
item.description: Despite being with the Lawrence Humane Society for three months, 2-year-old Sparky has not had any adoption inquiries, and shelter staff members hope that will change for Valentine’s Day. Continue reading ...

item.title: K-10 ramps in west Lawrence to close through May
item.description: Two K-10 ramps in west Lawrence are set to close next week through late May. Continue reading ...

item.title: Reminder: Douglas County treasurer’s office to move all services into satellite location from courthouse
item.description: Reminder: The Douglas County treasurer’s office will close its public-facing services in the historic courthouse downtown after this week and move all operations to the satellite location on Sixth Street. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners won’t restore free senior swim days as they await more data
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners considered reinstating free senior swim on Wednesdays at the Indoor Aquatic Center, but they chose to hold off until they have more data about rec center usage following fee implementation. Continue reading ...
